quotes.text: Did you do any unpaid work in that week (ending Sunday the [date] for any business that you own?
May I just check, is the main reason because you were... 1 ...looking after children? 2 looking after an incapacitated adult? 3 or some other reason?

May I just check, was the main reason that you did not look for work because... 1 Were you caring for children below school age, 2 Were you caring for other children,, 3 Were you caring for a dependent adult relative, 4 or some other reason?

assessments.reasoning: The survey questionnaire asks about unpaid work in a family business (OWNBUS) and records care responsibilities when asked as reasons for working part-time (YPTCIA) or for not looking for work (NOLWF). The indicator explicitly states that care given as a reason for not working or for not working more hours does not count. The instrument does not contain any questions asking whether a respondent supervises or remains available to care for household members, such as children, while performing other activities or without care being their main activity.
